findings: Fixed three local heartbeat/clock paths, bounded stable handle/path identity checks and private content-addressed exact bytes preserve observed generations.
Sanitized outputs retain field names/types and finite parsed epochs without raw article values/event IDs; trace exports filenames/function/line only.

Only a newly increased failure count after the initial baseline may trigger one later bounded SQLite mode=ro/query_only transaction; fixed SELECT/PRAGMA schema and original frozen predicate, 5s progress deadline, row/raw/private byte limits.
Original validators run on observed copies; no producer run_cycle, publication, GET, broker action or runtime write. Source closure and observer bytes are rechecked throughout and at completion.

The later database diagnostic and polled input generations are expressly not claimed to be the failed worker actual input; optional/missing clock field diagnostics are distinguishable from full producer validator outcomes.
limitations: Review only; no live/private captured files inspected and no tests rerun.
Polling can miss versions; named invalid field presence alone does not establish causal producer failure or host-clock drift.
The 600-second loop is bounded by clock/sample counts but a currently running bounded read/diagnostic can finish after the nominal stop.
